{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Fire Goat|kanji=丁未|romaji=hinoto hitsuji|onyomi=teibi|p=dīwèi|w=ting-wei|mi=tʰiŋ⁵³ weɪ̯|y=deng1 mei6|j=deng1 mei6|ci=tɛŋ mei|mc=tæŋ mei|oc-bs=tæŋ mei}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Fire Goat''' (丁未, ''hinoto hitsuji''; onyomi ''teibi'') is the 44th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 44th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Horse|ja|丙午|1=Yang Fire Horse}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Monkey|ja|戊申|1=Yang Earth Monkey}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''未'' (Goat) is Yin Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Fire Goat (丁未)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): dīngwèi
** Cantonese (Jyutping): ding1 mei6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoto-hitsuji
*** On'yomi: teibi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): jeongmi (정미)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Đinh Mùi

=== Events ===
* The conflict in {{ill|587|en|587|qid=Q30891|lt=587 AD|1=587}} between the {{ill|Soga clan|en|Soga clan|qid=Q909854|lt=Soga clan|1=Soga clan}} and the {{ill|Mononobe clan|en|Mononobe clan|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe clan|1=Mononobe clan}} is known as the {{ill|Soga–Mononobe conflict|en|Soga–Mononobe conflict|qid=Q534720|lt=Teibi Rebellion|1=Soga–Mononobe conflict}}.

==Months of Yin Fire Goat==
In a Common Era year, if the final digit is 2 or 7 (that is, when the Ten Heavenly Stems are {{ill|Ren|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren}} or {{ill|Ding|ja|丁|1=Hinoto (丁)|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ding}}), then {{ill|June|en|June|qid=Q120|lt=June|1=June}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month|1=Month}} of Teibi. However, the term “month” here may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Japanese Lunisolar Calendar}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Shōsho|1=Xiaoshu}} until the day before {{ill|Liqiu|en|Liqiu|qid=Q1147421|lt=Rittō|1=Liqiu}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yin Fire Goat==
=== Day Selection ===
A day of Teibi is the 15th day of {{ill|Ten Heaven, One Heaven|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ten Heaven, One Heaven|ja_comment=天一神|1=Tenitsu-shin|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
